output.owner_identity: Two real stable owner IDs in the frozen source fixture; A/B labels denote matrix positions, not generated persistent IDs.
output.requirement: Actual5WAV+manifest downloads and independent frame/rate/channel/hash/finite/peak/stem-sum/reference checks; no historical5second substitution.

bounds.output_bytes_scope: Per-job WAV bytes only; manifest has separate2MiB cap; not total IDB/page/transaction overhead.

DSP_state.method: One complete native OfflineAudioContext per tap; control/encode/persist chunks preserve the continuous single-graph DSP history.
DSP_state.release_policy: Process taps sequentially and release each full native PCM buffer before next tap where ownership permits; account assets/native buffers/staging/output residency in actual peak.
not_claimed: lossless state carry by concatenating separate contexts
unmeasured native callback CPU as zero
reference_requirements: Exact global sample origin, phase/pitch/cursor and single propagation delay
Chunk boundaries and whole output compared with independent full-span reference
Delay/filter/HRTF/IR/limiter state, motion/path birth/death and tails remain continuous
Original2e-6stem-sum tolerance and other original numerical/reference limits unchanged
Actual caps/cancel/quota/crash/incomplete publication tests; failure never Completed

change_policy: New version with explicit Root agreement and original criteria preservation; no quiet workload/cap/tolerance reduction.

archive_policy.aggregate_accounting: Charge WAV plus manifest bytes across retained archive jobs; maximum384MiB. This is defined payload accounting, not a claim of total IndexedDB page/filesystem/transaction overhead.
archive_policy.per_job_accounting: WAV payload maximum192MiB per job; manifest separate maximum2MiB.
archive_policy.metadata_bound: Maximum64 archived jobs, including bounded metadata/list enumeration; no unbounded metadata growth.
archive_policy.valid_preservation: Keep old valid jobs. Reject newly over-cap admission/publication with explicit reason; never silently delete valid jobs to admit another.
archive_policy.failure_semantics: Quota/cap/cancel/crash/incomplete jobs never publishCompleted; recover/discard must not corrupt retained valid jobs.
public_UI: Recover eligible retained/incomplete jobs with explicit state
Download retained WAV files and manifest
Explicit user delete of selected archive job
archive_policy.UI_authority: Normal product controls in Root sharedUI integration; bothComputerUse andPlaywright verification still required.
